summary: Iteration 126: Provider Health Dashboard & ProviderRouter Upgrade - ALL 11 BACKEND TESTS PASSED + FRONTEND UI VERIFIED. Tested new admin-only /api/provider-health endpoint with role-based access control (admin/owner only, 403 for non-admin), provider health data structure with lanes and per-provider metrics, and POST /api/chat returning rich provider metadata. Frontend Admin Panel Providers tab loads ProviderHealth component correctly showing lane sections (AI Providers, Market Data) with provider cards displaying status indicators, call counts, success rates, and latency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 126 tested the new Provider Health Dashboard and ProviderRouter upgrade. All features work correctly: (1) GET /api/provider-health returns lanes dict with per-provider health data (successes, failures, consecutive_failures, avg_latency_ms, last_error, cooldown_until, disabled), (2) Endpoint requires admin/owner role - non-admin users get 403 Forbidden, (3) POST /api/chat returns provider metadata as rich object with lane, name, type, model fields, (4) Frontend Admin Panel has 'Providers' tab (data-testid='admin-tab-providers') visible in tab bar, (5) Clicking Providers tab loads ProviderHealth component (data-testid='provider-health-tab') with lane sections (data-testid='lane-ai', 'lane-market_data') and provider cards (data-testid='provider-card-{name}'), (6) Provider cards show status indicators (healthy/cooldown/disabled), call counts, success rate, latency, and last success time.
